records.layer_detail: MES / electronic batch records for GMP (pharma, biotech) plus A1 manufacturing agents (process, quality, maintenance, supply chain, scheduling)
records.product_summary: Cloud manufacturing suite for GMP production (MES with electronic batch records, lab execution, a network linking sites and partners, analytics) plus A1, an agent on its own Apprentice 4.1 model that handles alarms, exceptions, paperwork and runs steps within set guardrails, with maintenance, supply-chain and quality sub-agents.

records.name: Arda
records.description_short: AI software that turns product designs into factory process plans, work instructions and station layouts, and updates them when designs change.

records.layer_detail: Design-to-production process planning: builds the bill of process (operations, tools, quality checks, fixtures, stations, visual work instructions) from CAD, PDFs and PLM data; propagates design revisions to the floor; feeds production data back for schedulers, supply-chain teams and technicians. Starting with manual assembly lines in defence and data-centre electrical equipment; prototyping agents that program robots.
records.product_summary: Agent-driven manufacturing-engineering software. It ingests CAD, PDFs, PLM data and requirements, builds a shared product model, then generates assembly order, operations, fixtures, station layouts and visual work instructions for engineers to review. It pushes design revisions to the floor and feeds production data back; robot-programming agents are in prototype.

records.name: Covalent
records.description_short: Boston software company (Covalent Networks) whose workforce-operations platform plans, trains and assigns frontline staff in discrete manufacturing.

sources.title: Powering the Workforce Behind Industrial Operations | Covalent
Boeing's Defense, Space & Security and Global Services Businesses Select Covalent to Provide Streamlined and Optimized Structured On-the-Job Training and Resource Management

records.layer_detail: Frontline workforce operations for complex discrete manufacturing (automotive, aerospace & defence): coverage and skills-gap planning, structured on-the-job, computer-based and instructor-led training (SCORM support), a live skills matrix, audit-ready qualification records, and AI-driven job assignment with eligibility gating. Boeing BDS and Global Services use its Capability Management module for structured OJT of mechanics and quality inspectors across dozens of sites.
named_customers: Boeing (Defense, Space & Security and Global Services businesses)
records.product_summary: Workforce-operations SaaS for industrial teams: plans headcount coverage and skill gaps, runs structured on-the-job and classroom training, keeps a live skills matrix and audit-ready qualification records, and assigns jobs only to qualified operators, giving frontline leaders real-time visibility of capability and bench strength.

records.layer_detail: Industrial IoT and AI operations platform (Faclon Intelligence Platform). It covers connectivity over Modbus, OPC, LoRa and HART (I/O Connect), dashboards and alerts (I/O Sense), no-code ML (I/O DeepSense) and the Bruce AI copilot, whose knowledge graph is built from SOPs and manuals. Solutions span energy and utilities, maintenance (condition-based monitoring and a maintenance management system), production and safety, and the company is pushing 'agentic AI' and an 'SEC-RCA Agent'. Delivered through dashboards and a copilot; no WhatsApp channel seen.
records.product_summary: Faclon Intelligence Platform: modular industrial IoT and AI software that connects machines over industrial protocols, provides dashboards, reports and alerts (I/O Sense), no-code forecasting models (I/O DeepSense) and a conversational copilot (Bruce AI) for diagnostics and root-cause analysis, applied to energy, maintenance, production and safety in plants.

records.name: Galvant
records.description_short: US start-up (formerly Takt) building AI agents that run quoting, procurement, AR/AP and reporting for small and mid-size manufacturers.
records.layer_detail: Manufacturing back-office agents on a shared data layer ('Galvant intelligence layer' over ERP, CRM, historian, bank feeds, email and spreadsheets). Named agents: Val (reads RFQs, pulls pricing, checks margin, drafts quotes), Kit (turns vendor emails into master POs, tracks change orders, matches packing slips to invoices), Billy (cash application, AR/AP reconciliation, claims) and Scout (analytics across ERP/historian data). A person approves every step. Claims go-live in days; dedicated Azure instance per customer. Channel is ERP/email/web, no WhatsApp seen.
records.product_summary: Agentic platform for manufacturers that unifies ERP, email, spreadsheet and plant data, then runs supervised workflow agents for RFQ quoting, vendor PO and invoice matching, AR/AP cash application and on-demand reporting, with human approval of each step and deployment in days rather than months.

records.name: Meridian
records.description_short: New York applied-AI start-up that maps how operations-heavy companies work and deploys governed, self-improving agents on their workflows.
records.layer_detail: Horizontal operations-agent platform (Context Cloud ontology, process discovery and mining, agent studio, evals and 'self-learning' benchmarks, human approvals, observability) sold to staffing, logistics, manufacturing and industrial-services firms. Manufacturing page pitch: 'AI workflows for reliable plant operations'; a 'Manufacturing ATLAS' of 24 agents across commercial, supplier and material, production and asset, quality and compliance, logistics, and finance domains. Showcased workflow is freight audit and pay / AP exceptions on SAP and NetSuite.
records.product_summary: Enterprise agent platform that maps an organisation's SOPs, systems and handoffs into a context ontology, turns completed work examples into tests and evals, then deploys agents across existing tools (ERP, email, drives) with human approvals and learning from execution failures, for operations-heavy industries including manufacturing and logistics.

records.layer_detail: Two parts. First, a procurement marketplace for metal manufacturers selling metal scrap, carbon additives, ferro alloys and branded products, backed by six warehouses and two scrap processing centres as of Apr 2026, with a WhatsApp bot for real-time prices and stock. Second, MetalCloud, AI SaaS that suggests how to optimise melting and that the company calls the 'core operating system for metal manufacturers'. The LinkedIn page says it is building 'the operating system for metal manufacturing' across procurement, quality and production. Overlaps Utopian Autonomy on procurement and process stability, within foundries and metal plants only.
records.product_summary: B2B marketplace supplying foundries and metal manufacturers with raw materials (metal scrap, carbon additives, ferro alloys) from its own warehouses and scrap processing centres, plus MetalCloud, AI-based SaaS that suggests melting optimisations; buyers see live prices and stock through a WhatsApp bot.

records.layer_detail: Started as autonomy tooling (hyper-realistic simulation that converts everyday video into interactive 3D digital twins, runs physics simulations with real robot software, integrates with NVIDIA Omniverse, Unreal and Unity). Now sells end-to-end robot integration: customer records a walk-through, Parallax trains the robot in the twin, then ships and installs it in about two weeks with 24/7 support; robots from OEMs such as FANUC and Standard Bots (100+ models supported). Member of A3, SEMI and ARM Institute.
records.product_summary: Turns a smartphone walk-through into an interactive digital twin, trains and stress-tests robots there using real robot software, then ships and installs a working robot in about two weeks with support and maintenance included, so manufacturers can automate tasks without long integration projects.
records.pricing: Zero Risk Policy: $0 until the robot does the task at KPIs agreed in writing; no pilot fees and no upfront hardware cost; deployment, 24/7 support and maintenance billed at a single hourly rate (rate not published).

records.layer_detail: Full-stack AI machine vision: cameras, lighting, AI software and line integration, including an EagleEye inspection station. Uses: surface and defect inspection, non-contact gauging and measurement, part counting, label, code and identity reading, and bin inventory verification. A 'Process & Video Analytics' offer turns existing cameras into production and dispatch counts reconciled with ERP. Verticals: automotive, pharma, electronics, bearings and metals, FMCG. Partner logos on the about page: Intel Partner Alliance (Advanced ISV Partner), HPE, NVIDIA, AWS Activate, NASSCOM.
records.product_summary: Turnkey AI machine-vision systems (cameras, lighting, AI software, line integration) for surface-defect inspection, non-contact gauging, part counting, code and label reading and bin inventory checks, plus analytics that turn existing cameras into production and dispatch counts reconciled with ERP; serves automotive, pharma, electronics, bearings and FMCG lines.
